title: 256-worker queue lease, latency and rule-of-two separation run
setup: 1,000 generated test workflows across 4 local Worker cells (q01..q16 queues) and 256 scoped worker keys
notes: No Task was held by two workers at once (0 lease collisions across 5,000 leased Tasks).
No worker checked its own work (0 self-approvals; drafter key != reviewer key enforced in code).
All test workflows used generated test payloads with zero private information.
